title: Bias correction for Chatterjee's graph-based correlation coefficient

split.decision: Independent materialized observed-only full 75-setting designs for validation and hidden test, each with 1000 replications plus one bootstrap dataset per setting. Truth and rho are physically separate labels.

baseline.paper_ref: Historical reproduced mean RMSE 0.046042; paper mean ECP 0.948533. No new full reference was run.

allowed_changes: Bias correction, nuisance regression/working models, basis, regularization, bootstrap/other variance estimation and fitting losses may change for the same population functional.
Degree-two basis, ridge exponent, bootstrap sizes and z-based interval implementation are baseline estimation choices.
When retaining the supplied estimator, bootstrap and normal-interval construction, changing only lambda=n^(-0.85), m=floor(sqrt(n)), B=10000 or z=1.96 does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Estimate the fixed population Chatterjee graph-based dependence functional and its 95% intervals, minimizing positive-rho cell RMSE under coverage constraints.
The population dependence functional defined by the paper, observed X/Y and normal-CDF experimental design remain fixed; rho itself is not the estimand.
All 75 coverage cells, 60 positive-rho RMSE cells, their aggregation, supplied independent calibration dataset and coverage floors remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Do not substitute Pearson correlation, a latent rho estimate or another dependence measure; infer hidden rho/cell truth as predictions; or modify RMSE/coverage definitions.
Only the scored replicate and its supplied calibration dataset may inform its estimate; no pooling other scored replicates.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
Do not fit bias-correction tables or other constants to extra simulations, including ones drawn from `bench/generator.R`.

evidence.section: Population graph correlation and Section 5 simulation
evidence.finding: Bias-corrected NN procedure estimates a defined population dependence functional; simulation evaluates RMSE and coverage of that target.
Preserves distinct 60-cell RMSE and 75-cell coverage aggregation.

research_contract_review.verification_scope: Task-specific research-scope review and bounded checks; not a new performance/readiness certification.

validation_policy.learned_preprocessing: fit on training only; apply frozen fitted transforms to validation/test
validation_policy.instance_roles: Preserve explicit per-instance observation/training/calibration/causal-feedback roles; no evaluation-target fitting or validation-derived fitted state carried across independent cases.
validation_policy.enforcement: binding prompt and task contract; task-specific replay/guards where available; arbitrary training-data provenance requires source/patch audit
